content.text:
CI is green on master. Spell Check was the only failing job. I pushed the fix as 5e14977, and all 7 jobs passed on it: CI, Spell Check, CodeQL, Secret Scan, SBOM, Scorecard and Deploy Status.

**Cause:** yesterday's Oracle EBS draft has SQL that queries `fnd_user`, `fnd_executables` and `fnd_profile_options`. The spell checker (typos) read `fnd` as a misspelling of "find". These are real Oracle table names (the FND prefix is Oracle's), so changing them in the post would have broken the SQL.

**Fix:** I added `fnd` to the allowed-words list in `_typos.toml`, with a comment saying where it comes from. I ran typos locally before pushing and it was clean. I installed it with Homebrew (`typos-cli`), so it's now on your machine too.

I also added a note to your Obsidian project file.
